      if (!(state.initialized)) Left(iMadzError("SIP_INITIALIZED", "定投计划尚未初始化，无法执行后续操作"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/SipPlan/AdvanceSkippedSipSlot/SIP_SCHEDULE_SEALED@507ba349b971b501
      else if (!(state.scheduleSealed)) Left(iMadzError("SIP_SCHEDULE_SEALED", "定投排期尚未封板，无法推进时钟或执行期次"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/SipPlan/AdvanceSkippedSipSlot/SIP_SLOT_DECLARED@d48704b49d2238b7
      else if (!((state.slots).contains(p.position))) Left(iMadzError("SIP_SLOT_DECLARED", "指定槽位序号不在定投排期范围内"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/SipPlan/AdvanceSkippedSipSlot/SIP_SLOT_MATCH@b920dfc362dce8f3
      else if (!(((state.slots)(p.position) == p.dueSlot))) Left(iMadzError("SIP_SLOT_MATCH", "请求的到期时刻与排期中登记的槽位时刻不一致"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/SipPlan/AdvanceSkippedSipSlot/SIP_SKIP_RECORDED@6d27f656dc255a8d
      else if (!(((state.slotDisposition).get(p.dueSlot)).contains("skipped"))) Left(iMadzError("SIP_SKIP_RECORDED", "指定槽位未被标记为暂停跳过，无法推进跳过游标"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/SipPlan/AdvanceSkippedSipSlot/SIP_SKIP_CURSOR_ONCE@4c4b2a1803fc6e13
      else if (!((p.position >= state.startCount))) Right(Nil)
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/SipPlan/AdvanceSkippedSipSlot/SIP_SKIP_CURSOR_ORDER@9c09ec2671008e14
      else if (!((p.position == state.startCount))) Left(iMadzError("SIP_SKIP_CURSOR_ORDER", "跳过游标必须按槽位顺序逐个推进"))
      else Right(List(SipSkippedSlotAdvanced(p.position, p.dueSlot)))
    }
  }
  // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/command/SipPlan/TriggerSipInstallment@521b0e86021994f0
  final class TriggerSipInstallmentRule(hosts: SipPlanComputations)
      extends InvariantRule[Event, State, TriggerSipInstallmentParams] {
    override def apply(state: State, p: TriggerSipInstallmentParams): Either[iMadzError, List[Event]] = {
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/SipPlan/TriggerSipInstallment/SIP_INITIALIZED@11bf9dd6d7069da3
      if (!(state.initialized)) Left(iMadzError("SIP_INITIALIZED", "定投计划尚未初始化，无法执行后续操作"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/SipPlan/TriggerSipInstallment/SIP_SCHEDULE_SEALED@507ba349b971b501
      else if (!(state.scheduleSealed)) Left(iMadzError("SIP_SCHEDULE_SEALED", "定投排期尚未封板，无法推进时钟或执行期次"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/SipPlan/TriggerSipInstallment/SIP_SLOT_DECLARED@d48704b49d2238b7
      else if (!((state.slots).contains(p.position))) Left(iMadzError("SIP_SLOT_DECLARED", "指定槽位序号不在定投排期范围内"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/SipPlan/TriggerSipInstallment/SIP_SLOT_MATCH@b920dfc362dce8f3
      else if (!(((state.slots)(p.position) == p.dueSlot))) Left(iMadzError("SIP_SLOT_MATCH", "请求的到期时刻与排期中登记的槽位时刻不一致"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/SipPlan/TriggerSipInstallment/SIP_OCCURRENCE_REPLAY_CONFLICT@58202add9a1a2910
      else if (!((!((state.occurrences).contains(p.dueSlot)) || ((((state.occurrences)(p.dueSlot)).revision == p.revision) && (((state.occurrences)(p.dueSlot)).config == p.config))))) Left(iMadzError("SIP_OCCURRENCE_REPLAY_CONFLICT", "该槽位已触发期次记录且与重放参数冲突"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/SipPlan/TriggerSipInstallment/SIP_OCCURRENCE_ONCE@46b1209b719e958d
      else if (((state.occurrences).contains(p.dueSlot))) Right(Nil)
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/SipPlan/TriggerSipInstallment/SIP_ACTIVE_START@132e19dfc59bd850
      else if ((state.paused)) Left(iMadzError("SIP_ACTIVE_START", "定投计划当前处于暂停状态，禁止触发新期次"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/SipPlan/TriggerSipInstallment/SIP_START_ORDER@6ea35e3580bf7f3f
      else if (!((p.position == state.startCount))) Left(iMadzError("SIP_START_ORDER", "定投期次必须按槽位顺序逐个触发"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/SipPlan/TriggerSipInstallment/SIP_BACKLOG_REQUIRED@eaa57370f3bdb020
      else if (!(((state.slotDisposition).get(p.dueSlot)).contains("backlog"))) Left(iMadzError("SIP_BACKLOG_REQUIRED", "该槽位尚未完成到期观测归类，无法触发期次"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/SipPlan/TriggerSipInstallment/SIP_REVISION_DECLARED@d636def5062a5582
      else if (!((state.revisions).contains(p.revision))) Left(iMadzError("SIP_REVISION_DECLARED", "所引用的定投修订版本未登记"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/SipPlan/TriggerSipInstallment/SIP_RETAINED_CONFIG@5160735448c9b0cd
      else if (!((((state.revisions)(p.revision) == p.config) && ((p.config).revision == p.revision)))) Left(iMadzError("SIP_RETAINED_CONFIG", "触发期次所用的配置与留存的修订配置不一致"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/SipPlan/TriggerSipInstallment/SIP_REVISION_INTERVAL@8231f7ac66ed04d2
      else if (!(((p.dueSlot >= (p.config).effectiveSlot) && (!((state.revisionEnds).contains(p.revision)) || (p.dueSlot < (state.revisionEnds)(p.revision)))))) Left(iMadzError("SIP_REVISION_INTERVAL", "该槽位不在所引用修订版本的有效区间内"))
      else for {
        stableSipOccurrence <- hosts.stableSipOccurrence(state, p)
      } yield List(SipInstallmentTriggered(p.position, stableSipOccurrence))
    }
  }

      else if (!(((state.createIntent).isEmpty || (state.createIntent).contains(p.intent)))) Left(iMadzError("SIP_INTENT_CONFLICT", "该计划已登记不同的定投创建意向记录"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/SipPlan/RecordSipCreateIntent/SIP_INTENT_EXISTING_CONFIG@d97fb719e6f4306e
      else if (!((!(state.initialized) || ((((p.intent).planId == state.id) && (state.revisions).contains(((p.intent).config).revision)) && ((state.revisions)(((p.intent).config).revision) == (p.intent).config))))) Left(iMadzError("SIP_INTENT_EXISTING_CONFIG", "定投创建意向与已初始化计划的配置不一致"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/SipPlan/RecordSipCreateIntent/SIP_INTENT_ONCE@46b94e7a3713a483
      else if (!((state.createIntent).isEmpty)) Right(Nil)
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/SipPlan/RecordSipCreateIntent/SIP_INTENT_BEFORE_CREATE@9a4bbe72afd718a8
      else if (!(((!(state.initialized) && (state.scheduleCount == 0L)) && !(state.scheduleSealed)))) Left(iMadzError("SIP_INTENT_BEFORE_CREATE", "定投创建意向必须在创建定投计划之前登记"))
      else Right(List(SipCreateIntentRecorded(p.intent, p.source)))
    }
  }

  def checkEventPostconditions(events: List[Event]): Option[iMadzError] =
    events.iterator.map(checkEventPostcondition).collectFirst { case Some(error) => error }

  private def checkEventPostcondition(event: Event): Option[iMadzError] = event match {
    case e: SipPlanCreated =>
      if (Option(e.planId).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipPlanCreated.planId 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.config).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipPlanCreated.config 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: SipPlanRevised =>
      if (Option(e.config).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipPlanRevised.config 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.previousRevision).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipPlanRevised.previousRevision 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: SipDueSlotObserved =>
      if (Option(e.disposition).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipDueSlotObserved.disposition 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: SipPausedDueSlotSkipped =>
      if (Option(e.disposition).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipPausedDueSlotSkipped.disposition 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: SipInstallmentTriggered =>
      if (Option(e.occurrence).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipInstallmentTriggered.occurrence 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: SipInstallmentPending =>
      if (Option(e.occurrence).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipInstallmentPending.occurrence 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.outcome).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipInstallmentPending.outcome 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: SipInstallmentOutcomeUnknown =>
      if (Option(e.occurrence).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipInstallmentOutcomeUnknown.occurrence 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.outcome).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipInstallmentOutcomeUnknown.outcome 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: SipInstallmentRecoveryRequired =>
      if (Option(e.occurrence).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipInstallmentRecoveryRequired.occurrence 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.outcome).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipInstallmentRecoveryRequired.outcome 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: SipInstallmentRefundInProgress =>
      if (Option(e.occurrence).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipInstallmentRefundInProgress.occurrence 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.outcome).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipInstallmentRefundInProgress.outcome 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: SipInstallmentSucceeded =>
      if (Option(e.occurrence).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipInstallmentSucceeded.occurrence 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.evidence).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipInstallmentSucceeded.evidence 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.receiptId).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipInstallmentSucceeded.receiptId 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.receiptBody).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipInstallmentSucceeded.receiptBody 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.outcome).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipInstallmentSucceeded.outcome 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: SipInstallmentFailed =>
      if (Option(e.occurrence).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipInstallmentFailed.occurrence 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.evidence).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipInstallmentFailed.evidence 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.receiptId).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipInstallmentFailed.receiptId 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.receiptBody).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipInstallmentFailed.receiptBody 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.outcome).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipInstallmentFailed.outcome 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: SipCreateIntentRecorded =>
      if (Option(e.intent).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipCreateIntentRecorded.intent 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.source).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "SipCreateIntentRecorded.source 不能为空"))
      else None
    case _ => None
  }
}
